scope: Harness-independent responsibility criteria. These are selection policies and precedents, not measurements of quality.

coordination.definition: Own scope, decisions, delegation, integration and final verification.

bounded-exploration.definition: Locate producers, consumers and evidence in bounded sources; provide an exact handoff without taking open critical decisions.

source-research.definition: Contrast primary sources, preserve citations and communicate missing or conflicting evidence.

proposal.definition: Formalize confirmed decisions; surface genuinely new questions rather than repeat the requirements interview.

requirements.definition: Preserve scenarios, invariants and semantics. Select effort by residual ambiguity and consequences, not a generic domain label.

architecture.definition: Resolve interfaces, integration, testing, migration and rollback while respecting established decisions.

task-planning.definition: Turn a complete design into scoped dependencies and slices. Planning tasks is not implementing them.

bounded-implementation.definition: Implement a closed contract. If design or diagnosis remains, do not assume a cheap worker is protected by a review that may not run.

semantic-verification.definition: Determine whether tests actually establish requirements and invariants; detect tautologies and omissions. Distinct from running frozen commands.

mechanical-verification.definition: Execute approved exact commands and return faithful evidence; do not redesign tests or approve scientific validity.

bounded-remediation.definition: Correct localized findings and re-verify; impact severity and intellectual complexity are separate dimensions.

semantic-integration.definition: Reconcile semantic deltas, preserved content and concurrent conflicts. A canonical merge is not a cheap administrative status update.

workspace-initialization.definition: Bounded setup with explicit expected state; not open-ended architecture or scientific validation.

workspace-orientation.definition: Map the existing workspace and entry points; does not replace researching the specific change.

status-reporting.definition: Report verifiable artifact state; do not infer correctness from completion labels.

independent-review.definition: Investigate findings independently from the writer within the native tools, context and review protocol.

critical-review.definition: Evaluate risk, reliability, resilience and refutation under explicit evidence and human-authorization boundaries.

visual-inspection.definition: Understand visual inputs using declared multimodal support; a text-only route requires an explicit, separately evaluated vision fallback.

commit-preparation.definition: Prepare an accurate bounded change summary; selection of this role grants no permission to commit.

memory-maintenance.definition: Maintain scoped memory with privacy constraints and exact provenance; memory is not automatically inherited by child agents.
